name: deployment
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: premium website editorial atlas illustration. Shared art direction: premium editorial future atlas, detailed hand-painted gouache and fine etched/woodcut linework, softly tactile paper grain, elegant architectural cutaway landscape with tiny varied human figures, cinematic layered composition, sophisticated and warm, richly saturated ultramarine/cobalt sky, deep petrol teal structures and vegetation, glowing vermilion/orange and apricot sunlight, touches of pale butter yellow and off-white. NOT photorealism, not glossy 3D, not vector-flat generic corporate art, not cyberpunk, not cartoon robots, no text/numbers/logos. Landscape 1536x1024; composition must work cropped to 3:2 or 16:10. Distinct clear foreground/middle/distance so exploring feels rewarding; dense relevant details but a strong legible central subject. No false exact data charts or identifiable political figures. These are imagined scenes, not future facts; any imagined-scene labeling will be provided outside the artwork by the website, so do not render any text. Cohesion is crucial: same palette, textured painting and tiny human scale across all three.

Scene: 2027–2029, intelligence at work. A beautifully drawn architectural cutaway of an open, humane creative workshop and laboratory overlooking a believable city: people collaborating at desks with understated luminous computer displays, precise robotic arm assisting physical work, compact data-centre racks below, electricity conduits visibly joining workshop and infrastructure; distant port/cranes suggest supply chains. Warm sun disk in rich blue sky. Main focus is human-work-machine-infrastructure relationship, not humanoid spectacle.
